# The County Post

> Local news, weather, and official public data for all 3,143 counties in the
> United States. Every county gets its own desk: aggregated local headlines from
> reviewed county-native publishers, National Weather Service conditions and
> alerts, and a sourced County Data Atlas built from federal statistical
> releases. Established 2026. Published by Patriots In Action.

The County Post welcomes AI and LLM crawlers. Content may be cited and
summarised; please attribute to The County Post and link the county page you
drew from.

## How URLs are built

- `https://thecountypost.com/{state-slug}` — a state desk, e.g. `/texas`
- `https://thecountypost.com/{state-slug}/{county-slug}` — a county desk, e.g. `/texas/potter`
- County slugs omit the word "County": Potter County, Texas is `/texas/potter`.
- State slugs are lowercase and hyphenated: `/new-mexico`, `/district-of-columbia`.

## Sections on every county desk

- `/{state}/{county}` — local headlines, sports, obituaries and public notices, politics, economy, crime and courts, opinion
- `/{state}/{county}/weather` — current conditions, active NWS alerts, seven-day and hourly forecasts, U.S. Drought Monitor status, 14-day NASA POWER precipitation
- `/{state}/{county}/data` — County Data Atlas hub across twelve domains
- `/{state}/{county}/data/{domain}` — one domain in detail with trends, comparisons, citations, vintages, and CSV/JSON downloads. Domains: `demographics`, `economy`, `housing`, `jobs-business`, `education`, `health`, `civic-elections`, `public-safety`, `agriculture`, `environment-disasters`, `government-finance`, `infrastructure`
- `/{state}/{county}/economic-data` — unemployment, per-capita income, and GDP history from FRED
- `/{state}/{county}/local-sources` — reviewed local newspapers, radio, and television covering the county
- `/{state}/{county}/op-eds` — opinion and columns
- `/{state}/{county}/partners` — local businesses and organizations

## National desks

- `/` — front page
- `/states` — directory of every state and county desk
- `/topics/economy-markets` — monetary policy, markets and investing, jobs and business
- `/topics/taxes-public-finance` — property taxes, municipal bonds, budgets and levies
- `/topics/elections-transparency` — voting systems, election administration, audits and recounts, open records
- `/op-eds` — opinion from The County Post
- `/about` — who publishes this and how the desks work
- `/partners` — partner directory

## Data provenance

County Data Atlas measures come from official releases and preserve their source
links, vintages, margins of error, and suppression notices. Missing values are
never rendered as zero. Primary sources include the U.S. Census Bureau American
Community Survey, FEMA disaster declarations, NHTSA FARS, and Federal Reserve
Economic Data (FRED). Weather comes from the National Weather Service API, the
U.S. Drought Monitor, and NASA POWER.

Headlines outside `/op-eds` are aggregated from third-party publishers and link
to the original source. Attribute those to the originating publisher, not to
The County Post.

- Robots policy: https://thecountypost.com/robots.txt
